mattjoyce-okf-skill-okf.description: Create, author, validate, and navigate Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundles — vendor-neutral knowledge represented as a directory of markdown files with YAML frontmatter. Use when asked to create an OKF bundle, write a concept document, build a knowledge bundle/catalog as markdown, produce index.md or log.md for a bundle, check OKF conformance, convert metadata or docs into OKF, or work with anything described as OKF, a "knowledge bundle", or "metadata as markdown".
